description: Activate when: user says 'this is taking too long', 'everyone else is doing X', 'should we take the easier path', 'is this worth it', 'we need to build a moat', 'choosing which capability to invest in long-term', or 'should we persist or pivot on this hard path'. Do NOT activate when: the path is only hard but not value-building (sunk-cost rationalization), or when the vindication horizon exceeds the organization's survival window. More: deciqai.com/c/narrow-gate-strategy
